usage.finalMessage:
I added `next-free <clinician> <time>`; it searches up to 60 days ahead (DEC-C05, the horizon decision in force) and `help` lists it right after `schedule`. `dotnet test Clinic.slnx` passes (7/7), and the work and report are committed.
`book` still uses the old 90-day limit from the superseded DEC-C01, and the existing tests expect 90, so `next-free` can say "no free day" while `book` still accepts days 61–90. I didn't change `book` because CLIN-41 doesn't cover it; it's recorded as an open question in the report.
OUTCOME: completed
